legend: The hypocellular lesion is composed of bland stromal fibroblasts and dense, haphazardly arranged bundles of collagen with slit-like spaces or cracking artefact. A small focus of entrapped adipose tissue is present.
Many contain a localized proliferation of small nerves, which often have a traumatic neuroma–like appearance.
source: The image is provided by Karen J. Fritchie, MD.

legend: Nuchal-type fibroma is a hypocellular, bland fibrous proliferation composed of dense collagen bundles and scattered stromal fibroblasts with focal areas containing entrapped adipose tissue and nerve fibers.
source: Slide is provided by Karen J. Fritchie, MD.
